hyperedges.label: Vendored Libraries Linked Into the Native Bridge

nodes.label: JNI Binding Shape (Native)
nodes.rationale: Native methods declared as instance private external funs (never @JvmStatic); symbol Java_app_versta_translate_bridge_<package>_<Class>_<method>; extern "C" with JNIEXPORT/JNICALL. Do not throw across JNI boundary - return 0/nullptr/0L and let Kotlin surface it.

nodes.label: jstr JNI String Helper
nodes.rationale: Convert strings with local jstr(JNIEnv*, jstring) helper; release GetStringUTFChars/GetStringUTFRegion buffers before returning.

nodes.label: Opaque Handle Pattern (Native)
nodes.rationale: One native struct per component; Kotlin holds a Long handle; instances kept in module-level std::unordered_map<jlong, std::unique_ptr<T>> keyed by monotonically increasing counter; jlong 0 means invalid and is never a real handle.

nodes.label: Ownership & Threading Contract
nodes.rationale: Native calls are blocking with no async API; Kotlin must call from background coroutine dispatcher. Protect shared native state with std::mutex, one lock per critical section. Model outlives session; mmap model files with documented lifetime contract.

nodes.label: whisper.cc Process-Loop Mutex
nodes.rationale: Example of protecting shared native state with std::mutex.

nodes.label: Vendored Git Submodules
nodes.rationale: third_party entries are git submodules (leanmt, whisper.cpp, espeak-ng, open-jtalk, cld2, opencv-mobile, onnxruntime, ocr-clipper, neon-sse). Never edit vendored source in place; per-ABI SIMD flags live here because AGP 9 leaks flavor arguments between ABI flavors.

nodes.label: C++17 Release Build Config
nodes.rationale: C++17 (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17). Release build only: -O3 -DNDEBUG; arm64-v8a adds -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod+fp16.

nodes.label: 16 KB ELF Page-Size Link Flag
nodes.rationale: Keep the 16 KB ELF page-size link flag (-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384).

nodes.label: Log.h Shared Header
nodes.rationale: Log through shared Log.h helper; never printf into production.

nodes.label: core/entity — Pure Domain Models
nodes.rationale: Pure domain models with no Android framework types, no ViewModel, and no MainApplication/composition-root access.

nodes.label: core/model — ViewModels
nodes.rationale: ViewModels own UI state via MutableStateFlow + asStateFlow(), expose Flows, orchestrate ports; keep combine/flatMap logic in the ViewModel, not the composable.

nodes.label: utils — Extension Functions Only
nodes.rationale: Extension functions only; never business logic.

nodes.label: Ports (Bare Kotlin Interfaces)
nodes.rationale: Ports wrap bridge classes so the rest of the app depends on the port, not the JNI wrapper; port is a bare interface, real and mock implementations sit beside it.

nodes.label: SQLDelight
nodes.rationale: SQLDelight for app data (language pairs, models, voices, OCR/speech models); schema in database/sqldelight/*.sq; never use SharedPreferences.

nodes.label: DataStore Preferences
nodes.rationale: DataStore Preferences (Context.dataStore) for user settings; reads are Flows with DEFAULT_* fallbacks; writes go through edit {}; never use SharedPreferences.

nodes.label: Manual Migrations
nodes.rationale: One MigrationN class per version in database/migrations/, registered in DatabaseContainer; add a new one when the schema changes, never edit an existing migration.

nodes.label: Timber Logging
nodes.rationale: Timber only via companion TAG; never android.util.Log or println; errors crossing a public boundary logged with Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, ...).

nodes.label: MutableStateFlow + asStateFlow State Pattern
nodes.rationale: ViewModel state is MutableStateFlow + asStateFlow(); one-off events and dialog visibility also modeled as state flows, not lambdas; UI collects with collectAsStateWithLifecycle().

nodes.label: Coroutines & Flow
nodes.rationale: Coroutines and Flow for all asynchronous work; no callback APIs; derive flows with map/distinctUntilChanged/combine.

nodes.label: JNI Bridge Pattern
nodes.rationale: Bridge classes own a native handle: private external funs, guard against handle == 0L, AutoCloseable, System.loadLibrary in the companion; blocking native calls run on a background dispatcher and never on the main thread.

nodes.label: ONNX Runtime (OrtEnvironment/OrtSession)
nodes.rationale: ONNX Runtime used ONLY for StyleTTS2 synthesis and OCR inference fallbacks.

nodes.label: Material 3 Expressive
nodes.rationale: Use MaterialTheme.spacing.* over hard-coded dp; prefer stringResource and vectorResource; never hard-code user-visible strings.

nodes.label: MeshGradientBackground
nodes.rationale: App-wide mesh gradient (Compose MeshGradientPainter) specced in /DESIGN.md; consult it before touching the backdrop's placement or colors.

nodes.label: androidTest Source Set
nodes.rationale: Tests live in app/src/androidTest mirroring the class package; one test file per class named XTest; run via connectedDebugAndroidTest.

nodes.label: *Memory/*Mock Test Doubles
nodes.rationale: Unit-style tests for core logic use *Memory/*Mock implementations only; scripts never real drivers, native libraries, file I/O, or the network.
